name: Topsy Products
old_description: Topy Products is an innovative custom design and fabricator. Every accessory we make requires in-depth design engineering and development. Creative thinking and attention to detail are key elements to designing and building a item to specification, on budget and on time. Innovation is at the heart of how our staff approaches each and every project. Keep an eye on us to see what we come up with next.
about:
Topsy Products operates from Oshkosh, Wisconsin, as a custom design and fabrication shop specializing in automotive accessories. The company focuses on developing engineered solutions for off-road vehicles, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures a range of hard-top removal systems and accessories for Jeep Wrangler models (JL, JK, TJ/YJ) and the Gladiator, as well as parts for the Ford Bronco. Its product line includes hinge hoist brackets and kits, hoist systems, door storage solutions, radio communications accessories, and general accessories. Each accessory undergoes in-house design engineering and development before fabrication.

Topsy Products serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting off-road enthusiasts and owners of Jeep and Ford Bronco vehicles. Its customer base includes individual consumers purchasing directly through the company’s online store, as well as potential wholesale or retail partners seeking specialized off-road accessories.

The company emphasizes innovation, creative thinking, and attention to detail as core differentiators, stating that every accessory requires in-depth design engineering to meet specifications on budget and on time. This innovation-driven approach is cited as the foundation of its product development process.
